staticMarkdownSelectors.target: Synonyms and antonyms
not a rule that every occurrence of 探偵 excludes police.
matches: 刑事 (けいじ) names a police detective in its person sense, whereas 探偵 is useful for a private investigator. This is a practical distinction, not a rule that every occurrence of 探偵 excludes police. 調査 (ちょうさ) is a broader investigation, inquiry or survey; it need not be secret. 調べる (しらべる) means to examine or investigate, and 探る (さぐる) includes probing into something unclear. None of these three by itself names the detective. There is no single useful antonym for this occupation or activity.
